title: Cricket Return-to-Training Block 1: Re-Entry Week 1
goal: Sport Performance (lean muscle gain support) for a recreational top-order cricket batsman, rebuilding movement quality and low-impact capacity while protecting a mild right knee.
athlete_analysis: 22-year-old male beginner, top-order batsman, training 5 gym days/week with cricket practice plus a Sunday match. Macro plan is in Block 1 (re_entry, weeks 1-2) with goals of pain monitoring, movement quality, and low-impact capacity. Right knee shows mild, occasional discomfort after long running and deep fatigue jumps, so this week uses no impact plyometrics or fatigue running and prioritizes hip control, hamstring/calf-soleus capacity, and trunk stiffness. Assessment shows a true beginner (1 pull-up, 12 push-ups, 45s plank, 25 bodyweight squats), so loads stay submaximal and pattern-focused using RPE/RIR and pain-free range. Sleep averages 6.5h with moderate stress, so we cap session intensity, avoid novel high-skill loading, and keep one variable progressing at a time. Saturday is kept light because Sunday is match day (avoid heavy legs day before match). Equipment (barbell, dumbbells, cable, bench, pull-up bar) supports goblet/landmine squats, dumbbell presses, machine/cable rows, calf capacity, and anti-rotation core. Sport transfer targets front-foot control, strike-rotation footwork, and fielding deceleration without aggravating the knee.

blocks.focus: Re-establish movement quality, build low-impact lower-body and trunk capacity, and protect the right knee while monitoring 24-hour pain response.
blocks.progression_logic: Progress only if 24-hour pain response stays at baseline. Hold or regress load/volume immediately if knee discomfort increases. One variable changed per week.

workouts.title: Lower-Body Movement Quality & Knee-Safe Strength
workouts.sport_transfer: Front-foot batting stability and fielding deceleration depend on hip control, knee tracking, and a stiff trunk. Goblet and landmine squats teach a balanced, knee-safe load position for repeated front-foot strides.
workouts.why_this_session: Re-entry week opens with low-impact, high-control lower-body work to rebuild squat and hinge quality without stressing the mild right knee through impact or deep fatigue.

warmup.name: Bird Dog
warmup.purpose: Activate trunk anti-rotation and hip control to prepare the spine for loaded patterns.
warmup.coaching_notes: Reach long not high, keep hips square, no lumbar extension.

warmup.name: Lateral Leg Swing
warmup.purpose: Open frontal-plane hip range for cricket fielding cuts and squat setup.
warmup.coaching_notes: Keep pelvis mostly level, no momentum-only kicking.

main_work.name: Goblet Squat
main_work.purpose: Teach knee tracking, depth control, and upright torso with a knee-friendly front load.
main_work.load_guidance: Stop 2-3 reps in reserve; depth only to pain-free range for the right knee.
main_work.coaching_notes: Hold weight to chest, open knees with control, keep heels planted. Stop set if knee discomfort appears.

main_work.name: Dumbbell Hip Thrust
main_work.purpose: Build glute and hamstring strength to offload the knee and power front-foot drive.
main_work.load_guidance: Moderate dumbbell, 2 RIR, full hip extension without low-back arch.
main_work.coaching_notes: Chin tucked, ribs down, squeeze glutes at top. Hold dumbbell steady on hips.

main_work.name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
main_work.purpose: Build calf-soleus and ankle capacity to support deceleration and protect the knee during running.
main_work.load_guidance: Bodyweight or light dumbbell, full controlled range.
main_work.coaching_notes: Use support for balance, rise through first two toes, no Achilles pain.

main_work.name: Pallof Press Overhead Reach
main_work.purpose: Train anti-rotation and anti-extension trunk control for batting rotation and fielding bracing.
main_work.load_guidance: Light cable/band; own the press-out before reaching.
main_work.coaching_notes: Reach up without ribs flaring, resist the pull, breathe steady.

cooldown.name: Calf Stretches (soleus bottom-squat lean)
cooldown.purpose: Restore ankle dorsiflexion used in squat depth and front-foot stride.
cooldown.coaching_notes: Lean knee forward gently, stop short of any knee or ankle pain.

injury_modifications: Keep all squat depth pain-free for the right knee; reduce range before reducing load.
Stop any set if knee discomfort appears and log 24-hour response.
No impact or jumping this session.

workouts.title: Upper-Body Push/Pull & Shoulder Durability
workouts.sport_transfer: A durable, controlled shoulder girdle supports throwing, bat-face control, and repeated fielding throws. Rows and face pulls build posterior shoulder capacity that protects the throwing arm.
workouts.why_this_session: Upper-body strength rebuild with balanced push/pull and scapular work, keeping the knee fully rested between lower-body days.

warmup.name: Band Pull-Apart
warmup.purpose: Activate posterior shoulder and scapular control before pressing.
warmup.coaching_notes: Keep ribs down, no neck tension.

warmup.name: Serratus Cable Punch
warmup.purpose: Prime scapular protraction for healthy pressing mechanics.
warmup.coaching_notes: Reach shoulder blade around ribs without twisting trunk.

main_work.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
main_work.purpose: Build horizontal pressing strength with a natural arm path and shoulder control.
main_work.load_guidance: 2 RIR, lower until upper arms near torso level under control.
main_work.coaching_notes: Set dumbbells over elbows before first rep, shoulder blades set on bench.

main_work.name: Chest-Supported Machine Row
main_work.purpose: Build upper-back strength with low low-back fatigue to balance pressing.
main_work.load_guidance: 2 RIR, control the path, no shoulder roll.
main_work.coaching_notes: Set chest pad so arms start long, drive elbows along handle path.

main_work.name: Face Pull
main_work.purpose: Train scapular retraction and external rotation to protect the throwing shoulder.
main_work.load_guidance: Light-moderate, smooth tempo.
main_work.coaching_notes: Set cable near face height, pull rope toward eyes, keep ribs and neck calm.

main_work.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
main_work.purpose: Develop lateral deltoid for balanced shoulder strength and durability.
main_work.load_guidance: Light, control neck tension.
main_work.coaching_notes: Slight elbow bend, raise in scapular plane, stop if any shoulder pinch.

cooldown.name: Leaning Bar Hang
cooldown.purpose: Decompress and stretch the shoulder girdle after pressing and pulling.
cooldown.coaching_notes: Toes on floor, take only comfortable shoulder range.

injury_modifications: No lower-body impact; knee fully rested.
Reduce lateral raise/press load if any shoulder pinch occurs.

workouts.title: Rotational Core, Calves & Low-Impact Conditioning
workouts.sport_transfer: Controlled rotation drives bat speed and fielding pivots; low-impact aerobic work builds the conditioning base for long fielding sessions without loading the knee.
workouts.why_this_session: Mid-week session trains rotational control and tissue capacity while keeping conditioning low-impact (cycle/row) to respect the macro plan's gradual-impact rule and the knee.

warmup.name: World's Greatest Stretch
warmup.purpose: Mobilize hips, hamstrings, ankles, and thoracic spine before rotational work.
warmup.coaching_notes: Keep breathing, do not force range.

warmup.name: Bird Dog
warmup.purpose: Reinforce trunk stability before loaded rotation.

main_work.name: Landmine Rotation
main_work.purpose: Train controlled loaded rotation and deceleration for batting and throwing transfer.
main_work.load_guidance: Light plate, rotate feet and hips with the bar, 3 RIR.
main_work.coaching_notes: Hold bar end close, no low-back rotation pain, move from hips not arms.

main_work.name: Standing Calf Raise
main_work.purpose: Build calf hypertrophy and tissue capacity to support running and knee protection.
main_work.load_guidance: Moderate, full stretch and full raise.
main_work.coaching_notes: Knees softly straight, control the bottom stretch.

main_work.name: Pallof Press Overhead Reach
main_work.purpose: Anti-rotation and anti-extension endurance for trunk durability in long innings.
main_work.load_guidance: Light, controlled.
main_work.coaching_notes: No rib flare, own the press-out first.

main_work.name: Low-Impact Aerobic Intervals (stationary bike or rower)
main_work.purpose: Build aerobic base for fielding endurance without knee impact.
main_work.load_guidance: Moderate efforts at RPE 6-7, pain-free; never sprint-loaded on the knee.
main_work.coaching_notes: Stop if knee discomfort appears; bike preferred over rower if knee flexion is sensitive.

cooldown.name: Calf Stretches (gastroc and soleus)
cooldown.purpose: Restore ankle range after calf loading and conditioning.

injury_modifications: Conditioning is low-impact only (no running/jumping) per re-entry phase and knee status.
Keep landmine rotation pain-free for low back and knee.
Reduce intervals to 4 if sleep was poor.

workouts.title: Full-Body Strength & Hip Control
workouts.sport_transfer: A guided landmine squat reinforces a knee-safe front-foot load position, while pressing, rowing, and pullovers build the upper-body durability needed for throwing and bat control.
workouts.why_this_session: Main full-body strength day placed mid-week with two full recovery days before the Saturday primer and Sunday match, building capacity while keeping the knee protected.

warmup.name: Band Pull-Apart
warmup.purpose: Wake up the scapular stabilizers before pressing and rowing.

warmup.name: Lateral Leg Swing
warmup.purpose: Prepare hips for loaded squatting and lateral fielding patterns.

main_work.name: Landmine Squat
main_work.purpose: Teach a knee-friendly loaded squat with a guided bar arc and front load.
main_work.load_guidance: 2 RIR, depth to pain-free range, lean slightly into the arc.
main_work.coaching_notes: Hold sleeve to sternum, control bar path, heels planted. Stop if knee discomfort appears.

main_work.name: Machine Chest Press
main_work.purpose: Train horizontal pushing with low stability demand to manage fatigue on a strength day.
main_work.load_guidance: 2 RIR, handles start at mid-chest.
main_work.coaching_notes: Shoulder blades against pad, no shrug.

main_work.name: Machine Row
main_work.purpose: Build back strength and size with a controlled path after squatting fatigue.
main_work.load_guidance: 2 RIR, pull elbows back without rolling shoulders.
main_work.coaching_notes: Fit handles to torso, controlled return.

main_work.name: Dumbbell Pullover
main_work.purpose: Train lats and serratus through a long arc for overhead shoulder capacity and trunk control.
main_work.load_guidance: Light-moderate, lower only to controlled shoulder range.
main_work.coaching_notes: Ribs down, no rib flare, stop short of shoulder discomfort.

cooldown.name: Leaning Bar Hang
cooldown.purpose: Decompress shoulders and lats after pressing and pullovers.

injury_modifications: Keep landmine squat depth pain-free for the right knee.
No impact work; this is the last loaded leg session before match day.
Log 24-hour knee response before progressing next week.

workouts.title: Pre-Match Primer: Mobility, Activation & Cricket Movement Prep
workouts.sport_transfer: Light activation and cricket-specific movement rehearsal prime front-foot footwork, fielding ready-position, and throwing mechanics so the athlete arrives fresh and sharp for Sunday's match.
workouts.why_this_session: Match-day-minus-1 rule requires avoiding heavy legs, exhaustive conditioning, and novel high-impact work. This is a low-volume primer that keeps the knee fresh and reinforces sport patterns without fatigue.

warmup.name: World's Greatest Stretch
warmup.purpose: Full-body dynamic prep for hips, hamstrings, ankles, and thoracic rotation.

main_work.name: Bird Dog
main_work.purpose: Light trunk activation to prime bracing for batting and fielding.
main_work.load_guidance: Bodyweight, low effort.
main_work.coaching_notes: Hips square, reach long, no fatigue.

main_work.name: Band Pull-Apart
main_work.purpose: Activate posterior shoulder for throwing readiness without load.
main_work.load_guidance: Light band.
main_work.coaching_notes: Ribs down, smooth.

main_work.name: Shadow Batting to Target Line (cricket movement rehearsal)
main_work.purpose: Rehearse front-foot defense and drive footwork and head position for match readiness.
main_work.load_guidance: No load; controlled, low-intensity technical rehearsal only.
main_work.coaching_notes: Complete trigger before release, level eyes, head toward contact line, straight bat path. Keep it crisp, not tiring.

main_work.name: Fielding Ready-Position & Long Barrier Rehearsal (low speed)
main_work.purpose: Prime hips-low ready position and safe stopping technique for Sunday fielding.
main_work.load_guidance: Low speed, predictable; no diving or full-speed deceleration to protect the knee.
main_work.coaching_notes: Eyes to ball, hips low, soft hands, body behind ball. No fatigue or impact reps.

cooldown.name: Calf Stretches (light) and Lateral Leg Swing
cooldown.purpose: Leave hips and ankles loose and relaxed for match day.
cooldown.coaching_notes: Gentle, pain-free, no deep stretching to fatigue.

injury_modifications: No heavy legs, no impact, no diving the day before the match (MD-1 rule).
Keep total volume low to arrive fresh for Sunday.
Skip or shorten if knee is sore; substitute a pure mobility/recovery flow.

nutrition_focus: Support lean muscle gain on a vegetarian diet with a small calorie surplus (~250-350 kcal). Target ~1.6-2.0 g/kg protein (~120-150 g) using dairy (milk, paneer, curd, whey), legumes, soy, and eggs if acceptable. Anchor protein and carbohydrate around evening training and the Sunday match. Milk is a convenient vegetarian weight-gain and recovery aid. Prioritize whole-food carbs for training energy and hydrate well for Hyderabad heat.
recovery_focus: Sleep is the priority lever at 6.5h average; aim to add 30-60 min toward 7.5-8h to protect a beginner's progress and knee recovery. Use light foam rolling for calves and quads (expect some discomfort that eases over weeks), monitor 24-hour knee response after each lower-body day, and keep moderate stress in check with consistent wind-down. On low-sleep days, cut volume 20-40% and keep technical work submaximal.
safety_notes: Right knee is mild and only flares after long running or deep fatigue jumps; this week uses no running impact, no jumping, and pain-free squat depth.
Stop any set if knee discomfort appears and reduce range before load. Hold or regress if 24-hour pain
